evals.name: plain-html-add-entrance-and-hover
evals.prompt: I have a plain static HTML landing page — no build tools, no framework, I just edit index.html and open it in the browser. I want to add some motion: make the hero section fade in when it scrolls into view, and make the 'Get Started' CTA button grow a little when you hover it. I'd like to use Wix's @wix/interact library for this. Walk me through it and give me the code.
evals.expected_output: Sets up @wix/interact via the /web (custom-element) entry point loaded from a CDN (no build step). Registers presets with Interact.registerEffects before create/generate. Hero: viewEnter trigger + FadeIn namedEffect with triggerType:'once', wrapped in <interact-element data-interact-key=...>, with FOUC handled correctly (injected generate(config, true) output). CTA hover-grow avoids the hit-area-shift pitfall (animates a child via selector, or uses a state/transition effect, or targets a separate key) rather than scaling the same hovered element. generate() called with useFirstChild=true for the web entry point. Config validated with validateInteractConfig before emit (scratch script); no @wix/interact-validate in shipped index.html. No invented preset names; no Bg*/DVD presets.
assertions: Uses @wix/interact correctly: imports the Interact API and calls Interact.create(config) with a valid InteractConfig.
Config is structurally valid: would pass validateInteractConfig with no errors.

Shipped output contains no @wix/interact-validate, validateInteractConfig, assertValidInteractConfig, or InteractValidationError reference — scope: shipped CODE files only (a mention in EXPLANATION.md/docs is fine).
Registers presets before use: Interact.registerEffects(...) is called BEFORE create/generate when a namedEffect is used.
Hero entrance correct: trigger 'viewEnter' + FadeIn namedEffect with triggerType:'once'.
FOUC handled: generate() output injected.
generate() useFirstChild matches the entry point (true for /web custom elements, false for vanilla).
Hover-grow avoids hit-area shift: scales a child/separate target or uses a state/transition effect, not the same hovered element.
No invented or forbidden presets (no Bg*/ImageParallax/DVD/made-up names).
Runnable with no build step: index.html is self-contained (CDN/module import).

Static CSS at generation time: the interaction CSS is embedded in index.html as a literal <style> block (or linked .css) pre-generated while authoring, rather than only being produced by a generate() call that runs in the browser at load time.

evals.name: react-add-mouse-tilt-and-scroll-parallax
evals.prompt: I'm building a product showcase in a React app (Vite + TypeScript). Two things I want to add with @wix/interact: (1) the product cards should tilt toward the cursor in 3D as you move the mouse over them, and (2) the big hero background image should have a subtle parallax effect as you scroll down the page. Can you set this up?
evals.expected_output: Uses the @wix/interact/react entry point: <Interaction> components, Interact.create inside useEffect with instance.destroy() cleanup, generate(config, false). registerEffects called once. Tilt: pointerMove + Tilt3DMouse/Track3DMouse scrub effect (rangeStart/rangeEnd, fill:'both'), gated behind (hover: hover), targeting a child wrapper. Parallax: viewProgress + ParallaxScroll (NOT BgParallax/ImageParallax) on the image; mentions overflow:hidden->overflow:clip. Config validated with validateInteractConfig before emit. No validator reference in shipped source unless user asked for CI guard. No invented presets.
assertions: Uses the React entry point: imports from @wix/interact/react and uses <Interaction> with tagName + interactKey.

Correct React lifecycle: Interact.create inside useEffect with instance.destroy() cleanup.
generate() uses useFirstChild=false (correct for React).
Registers presets before create/generate.

evals.name: edit-existing-config-slide-and-stagger
evals.prompt: Attached is my current setup (index.html + interactions.js). Right now the hero just fades in when it enters the viewport. I want two changes: (1) make the hero slide in from the left instead of fading, and (2) make the four feature cards stagger-fade in one after another as they scroll into view. Please update my files and keep the existing setup working.
evals.expected_output: EDITS the existing files in place. Hero: FadeIn -> SlideIn with direction:'left', preserving effectId 'hero-in', key 'hero', viewEnter, triggerType:'once'. Cards: staggered entrance via a sequence (offset + offsetEasing) fired by a single viewEnter trigger, with the sequence's effect carrying a selector that picks the .feature-card items (one trigger fanning across the cards — the selector case, not per-card listContainer) — not per-card delays; keys a single wrapper (the grid/section) so the cards bind. Because the cards are source ≠ target (trigger on the wrapper, effect's selector fans across the cards), generate() emits no FOUC-hiding rules for them, so the card entrance effect sets fill:'backwards' to hold each card in its first-keyframe state before it enters. Preserves registerEffects, generate(config, true), Interact.create and the web entry point. Edited config validated with validateInteractConfig; no validator reference left in edited files. Targeted edit, valid references.
assertions: Hero switched to SlideIn from the left (namedEffect SlideIn, direction:'left', replacing FadeIn).
Hero identity preserved: effectId 'hero-in', key 'hero', trigger 'viewEnter', triggerType:'once'.
Edited config is structurally valid: would pass validateInteractConfig; all effectId/sequenceId references resolve.

Shipped edited files contain no @wix/interact-validate, validateInteractConfig, assertValidInteractConfig, or InteractValidationError reference — scope: shipped CODE files only (a mention in EXPLANATION.md/docs is fine).
Cards stagger via a sequence (offset; offsetEasing optional) whose effect uses a selector to fan across the cards (the one-trigger stagger case, not per-card listContainer).
Cards use the viewEnter trigger.
Cards actually bound: keys a single wrapper (interact-element/data-interact-key on the grid/section) and the sequence effect's selector matches the .feature-card items.
Card entrance effect sets fill:'backwards' (source ≠ target, so generate() emits no FOUC-hiding rules for the cards).
Existing setup preserved: registerEffects, generate(config, true) (at generation/build time or runtime), Interact.create, and the /web entry point intact.
Targeted edit, not a rewrite: unrelated structure preserved.
No invented or forbidden presets (SlideIn/FadeIn are real).
